scope: Auxiliary finite-product geometry. Shift delta <=(1+epsilon)g and ranked g-distance imply actual complex factor product <=(N+1)exp(epsilon H_N). Finite real sets are sorted by their genuine order embedding; ordered gap implies rank distance. Any open interval of width <=3g contains at most three g-separated points. Six standard-axiom interfaces and two expanded examples pass independently; no original numbered target claimed.
